## Three promises, built into the hardware.

### It stays on the box

The assistant runs entirely on the device. Your questions, your memories, your data — none of it is transmitted anywhere. Not to us, not to anyone. Verify it yourself: it has no reason to phone home, and it doesn't.

### You own the machine

A physical computer you buy once — no subscription to keep it running, no cloud account to lock you out. Advanced users get full shell access; everyone else never needs it.

### It tells you the truth

A local model is capable, not magic — and the device is candid about it. It always shows which brain answered and how it's running. No hidden state, no dark patterns.

## A face on your desk. A chat in your pocket.

Set it up on the touchscreen in two minutes — no computer required. Then pick it up from your phone whenever you like. Both are served straight from the device.

### A living presence

A touchscreen that shows the assistant's state at a glance and answers right there — the same breathing orb, the same honest readout.

### Paired in one scan

Scan the code on screen and a private chat opens — no app store, no account, no cloud relay in between. Just you and your machine.

"Hey Sam — running about 10 behind, see you shortly." Want me to send it?

## No mystery hardware. No mystery software.

> PHNTM exists to give people ownership of their intelligence.

We see a future where advanced AI doesn't have to live inside a distant data center, depend on a monthly subscription, or ask you to surrender control of your personal information. Intelligent systems should be able to run locally, learn alongside their owners, protect their privacy, and become more useful over time.

PHNTM is being built as a persistent, autonomous intelligence platform — combining local AI, memory, RAG, perception, automation, self-maintenance, and eventually robotics into one evolving system.

The goal is not to build another chatbot.

The goal is AI that lives on your hardware, understands your world, remembers what matters, takes meaningful action, improves through experience, and stays under your control.
